name: Floor & Decor PRO Premier Credit Card

localized_names.en: Floor & Decor PRO Premier Credit Card

categories.label: Qualifying Floor & Decor purchases (2026 promotion, in lieu of special financing)

notes: Business card for Floor & Decor PRO customers with Net 30 terms. Synchrony lists Floor & Decor among its commercial credit cards. The 5% back is a statement credit on qualifying purchases made between 1/1/2026 and 12/31/2026, offered as an alternative to 180 days special financing on purchases of $299 or more. The standard APR is not stated on the page. It is a closed-loop private-label card that does not run on a payment network, so network is other and network_tier is none.
